newsitem.title: USA: Sled Dogs settles with boot supplier.
newsitem.headline: Sled Dogs settles with boot supplier.

text.p: Sled Dogs Co said it has reached an agreement to pay Minson Enterprises Co Ltd , its snow skate boot supplier, $410,000.
The amount, to be made in several payments, is the amount Sled Dogs owed Minson Enterprises but had not paid due to cash flow considerations, Sled Dogs chief financial officer Mike wise said Monday.
The snow skate maker said it had accounted for the payment in previous earnings reports.
Sled Dogs shares were unchanged at 9/32 Monday.
